title: Temperature Compensation of Wind Tunnel Balance Signal Detection System Based on IGWO-ELM
authors: Xiang Dong | Hu Xu | Huibin Cao | Tao Cui | Yuxiang Sun
locator: Sections on calibration and high–low temperature tests; Figs 6–9; Table 2; data availability
finding: Calibration used an external standard force source with three repeats. The detection system underwent two-hour dwells at eight chamber temperatures from −40 to 80 °C. An 80/20 observation split is reported. No synchronized load at every thermal point, independent test run or board-versus-transducer thermal attribution is established. Previously screened out as electronics; included here only as a metrology comparator.

title: Low-Patching-Error Fiber Bragg Grating Multi-Dimensional Force Sensor
authors: Shu Jiang | Huachuan Huang | Tao Li | Zhibin Ye | Shiyu Yang | Deming Hu
locator: Figs 13–15 and Table 3; description of 10 N weights (0.1% accuracy class)
finding: Standard weights supply independent nominal loads along each of three directions. Ascending 20 N steps to 200 N followed by descending steps to zero; repeated at least three times. Published X and Z error magnitudes decline from 0.90 to 0.27 N and 5.73 to 0.62 N after changing the beam design. No torque or thermal calibration series in that test.
